content.comment_body: Is it possible to adjust weekly time control parameters through the web server interface?

Yes, this can be done. However, to clarify, which web server are you referring to? [product_name] with [version_no] only features a basic web server. More recent versions like [product_name] with [version_no] and above have both a basic and an extended web server. Could you specify which web server you are asking about?

analysis.insight_summary: There is uncertainty among users regarding the ability to modify weekly time control parameters via the web server interface, particularly due to different capabilities across hardware versions. The discussion centers on which versions provide basic versus extended web server functionality and how that affects remote control features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that weekly time control parameters can be modified remotely through the device's web server interface, regardless of hardware version.
